content: Implement Chromium canary assignment for rahul06-k: 1) --inject-candidate-id switch injecting X-Candidate-Canary header, 2) console.warn('canary-ping') hook logging [CANARY_ACK] to stderr. Keep patch under 60 lines and avoid editing headers.

prompt: Find where console.warn executes in third_party/blink/renderer/ and verify allowed base/ headers in Blink DEPS.

result: Found third_party/blink/renderer/core/frame/frame_console.cc in FrameConsole::AddMessage. base/logging.h and base/time/time.h are allowed under Blink DEPS.

prompt: Trace CommandLine propagation across process boundaries in render_process_host_impl.cc and find URLLoaderThrottle hook points.

result: render_process_host_impl.cc uses kSwitchNames to propagate flags to child renderers. Add 'inject-candidate-id' to kSwitchNames. In chrome/renderer/url_loader_throttle_provider_impl.cc and chrome_content_browser_client.cc, subclass blink::URLLoaderThrottle and implement WillStartRequest to inject X-Candidate-Canary.

summary: Generated unified patch candidate_canary.patch touching 4 .cc files with 47 lines changed. No header rebuild triggered.
